item: P6.1 structural-floor peak tokens (derived from maxactivating_v2.json)
desc: Per emotion, the top-20 max-activating windows' single PEAK TOKEN and its structural category. Window text, positions, and projection values are NOT included; only the isolated peak token per window is retained. This is the exact input the P6.1 floor classifier consumes: run scripts/analyze_maxact_peaks.py to recompute the 52.6% rank-1 floor and 48.4% top-20 rate.
classifier: scripts/analyze_maxact_peaks.py classify(): whitespace/newline | numeric | punctuation/symbol | function_word | content

_provenance.note: Isolated peak tokens only; no third-party window spans. Reproduces P6.1 floor from shipped files.
